label: coefficient-code-and-arith
command:
grep -n "func.*[Dd]amage\|1200\|ReturnRate\|0\.5" internal/core/combat.go | head -20; grep -n "charge_power\|FxChargePower" internal/core/rules.go | head -3; python3 -c "
assert int(1240*1.52)==1884 and round(1240*1.52,1)==1884.8
assert int(1240*1.55)==1922
assert abs(1.5 - 0.5*1.2 - 0.5*1.2*0+0.1*0)>=0
print(\"OK 1884.8/1884, 1922\")"
